# A Canadian company exchanges US dollars for Hong Kong dollars, and writes
# the exchange wholly in Hong Kong dollars.
#
# The US dollars leave a cost basis that cost 1.30 — 1,300.00 CAD for 1,000.00
# USD — and 7,800.00 HKD arrive. Nothing in the transaction is in Canadian
# dollars, so no split can state what the exchange realized, and the Hong Kong
# dollars arrive with no cost to open a cost basis at: the 1,300.00 of cost
# would leave the book with nothing to show for it. So it is refused, as a
# share sale written wholly in a foreign currency is, and written again in
# Canadian dollars with `$residual$`.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_currency_exchange_stating_no_canadian_figure_is_refused.py.
2037-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2037-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2037-01-01 commodity HKD
	mnemonic: "HKD"
	fullname: "Hong Kong Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2037-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2037-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2037-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2037-01-01 open Assets:HKD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2037-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2037-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2037-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 5000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -5000.00 CAD

2037-01-05 * "Buy 1,000.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 1000.00 USD
		guid: "b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b70001"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "1300.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1300.00 CAD

2037-02-01 * "Exchange 1,000.00 USD for 7,800.00 HKD, stated in HKD"
	currency.mnemonic: "HKD"
	Assets:USD Bank -1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "39/5"
		value: "-7800.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b7b70001"
	Assets:HKD Bank 7800.00 HKD
